notes.title: Update 7.00
notes.content:
Changes in the update
Added the ability to change the weather

Added new character skins: Colander, Nimbus

New block: Small ballast

Now on multiplayer maps, if hit hard enough, trees fall

Increased the accuracy of block positions and rotations in world saves

Added the ability to interact with some blocks around the seat in first-person mode

Added translation of messages in the chat

Added the ability to transfer any numbers between mathematical blocks


Balance changes
The damage of a heavy cannon and its modification has been increased

Reduced damage from the explosion of a heavy gun and its modification

Now the damage of the AP bullets depends on the length of the barrel

The health of the cameras is increased

The number of shells in big ammunition increased

Thermal traps now interfere with the view through the night vision camera

The maximum weight of the ballast is increased

Fixed glass blocks weight


Fixes
Fixed bearings falling off in some cases when welding

Disabled  tag in signs and text stickers

Added a limit on the length of the server name

Added a warning about connecting an ammo rack to a gun on another root

Fixed the sound turning off when entering different menus during the game

Fixed and / or removed the collision of some objects on the "Ruined City" map

Rangefinder and distance sensor now detect water on all multiplayer maps

Improved the display of colors by glowing custom blocks on mobile devices and when the "Bloom" is disabled

Disabled the ability to enter the seat settings in team multiplayer modes

Changed the colors of clouds and lighting after sunset

Changed the aiming point

Now the custom pontoon is not deleted when blocks are detected inside it, instead it reduces health

Fixed a bug due to which the draw distance above 20 chunks was not applied

notes.title: Update 6.00
notes.content:
Changes in the update

 New blocks: Small shock absorber and Glowing custom block
 New damage panel and option to return a full list of destroyed blocks
 Added daily combat missions
 New character skin: Keg
 Added more possible barrel lengths for some guns
 On mobile devices, the location of some buttons has been changed and the "Down" button has been added
 The "Ruined City" map has been added to the map selection in the battle against bots in a single game
 Added the ability to transfer the server administrator
 Added a "Move" button to the seat
 Improved optimization of destruction
 Slightly changed the main menu


Balance changes

 Returned the ability to completely disable the anti-bug
 Reduced the overload effect
 Improved the night vision camera
 Reduced the weight of newly saved buildings
 Hover power has been increased by 2 times
 Increased the flight speed and damage of the medium rocket launcher, added spread
 Increased the flight speed of the small rocket launcher
 Changed gravity in space
 Increased shock absorber durability


Fixes

 Fixed custom blocks falling off the building
 Fixed the seat camera passing through the map
 Fixed incorrect operation of the math block in some cases, added a new operator and an explanation about operator priorities
 Fixed speedometer block settings
 Fixed ATGM guidance from a building at high speed
 Fixed propeller behavior in space
 Fixed localization of quick messages
 Fixed a bug with the shock absorber strength after changing the damper and strength


Screenshots from CaMo/lETI/IK and Atsosik from Discord server

notes.title: Update 5.00
notes.content:
Changes in the update

 Added the ability to change the barrel length of some cannons
 Added a math block
 Improved training
 Added display of overload and the overload effect in the seat
 Added the ability to enable reflections in the graphics settings, and also added the "Cinematic" graphics preset
 Slightly changed the appearance of the heavy cannon
 Disabled autosave when loading the current world
 Added a note about the current world in the world selection
 The character now moves together with the building on which he stands


Balance edits

 Fixed a non-working points multiplier every N blocks
 Changed the strength points of all blocks
 Gravity (including shells) increased by 2 times, strength increased by 1.75 times shock absorbers
 Changed propeller thrust
 Magnet power points now depend on its settings
 Slightly increased autocannon damage
 Maximum power and speed of small and large engines increased


Corrections

 Fixed movement of bearings and shock absorbers
 Fixed display of players on the minimap
 Fixed the operation of the "Always show players on the minimap" option
 Fixed display of half-block points in the pause menu


Screenshots from CaMo/lETI/IK and Atsosik from Discord server

notes.title: Update 4.00
notes.content:
Changes in the update

Fixed some effects that did not react to the lighting level
Improved gunshot effects
Added a button to go to the settings of the connected block from the block settings
Changed the panel for creating a single-player world
New skins: Christmas tree toy, Pill
Added display of the number of buildings by category at the exhibition
Changed the reset function: inventory and world settings are no longer reset
When creating a world, the ability to enable the display of damage inflicted has been added
Changed the autosave function: now when creating a world, you must enter its name, and automatic saving will occur in this world
Added the ability to enter an exact angle in the welding machine
Added a mode for fighting bots in a single-player game
Added a shaking setting cameras


Balance changes

Propellers are now removed by anti-bug
Engines no longer deal explosive damage when destroyed
Increased durability and mass of engines
Decreased propeller power
Decreased dynamic protection mass
Increased durability and points of wheels


Corrections

Fixed display of propellers and shock absorbers at the exhibition
Fixed launch of guided missiles at high speed
Fixed operation of the medium gun modification with ammo rack
Multi-deletion now removes blocks in blocks
Fixed a bug with buttons on mobile devices

notes.title: Update 3.00
notes.content:
Changes in the update:

Added a mode of battle with bots: "Rise of the Machines"
Increased transparency of effects of hitting the ground
Added 4 and 5 servers
Now after changing the armor gain, all new blocks appear with the same armor gain
Added the "Pumpkin" skin


Balance changes

Increased the maneuverability of the AGM by 2 times
The AGM now has a HE warhead
The capture radius of the AGM has been increased by one and a half times
The large rocket launcher no longer captures through smoke
The flight speed of the rockets of the small rocket launcher has been increased by one and a half times
Decreased the accuracy spread when launching several ATGMs
HE with a radio fuse no longer explodes on the ground and other parts of the map


Fixes

Fixed loading of buildings when entering the server
Fixed firing delay for all turrets
Fixed keyboard input in some fields in block settings
Fixed speed input and display in the speedometer block
Ammo racks are now automatically replenished when a building spawns
Fixed connection points for blocks in blocks after building spawn
Fixed self-destruction at high speed
Fixed input in the grid size field in the custom block editor on PC
Fixed editing custom blocks on large buildings when time is slowed down

notes.title: Update 2.00
notes.content:
Changes in the update:

New custom block editor
1 block is now 0.5 meters: this did not affect anything except the numbers on the interface
You can now connect several blocks to the input of another block at once
A store button has been added to the pause menu in team multiplayer modes
A camera preview has been added to the camera block settings
Improved optimization of buildings with blocks in blocks


Balance changes

AP damage for the heavy gun has been increased
Increased slowdown of the building with small wings
Now before self-destruction, the seat has a spark effect
Disabled changing the appearance of armor upgrades
Now when upgrading armor, the mass of the block increases less: the same number of times as its durability block
Maximum speed and power of the big engine increased to 150
Camera block mass increased


Corrections

Fixed display of mass of some blocks in the guide

notes.title: Sandbox World Released on Steam
notes.content:
I am happy to announce that after over 3 years of development and testing, Sandbox World is coming to Steam!

Over the years, 10,000 buildings have been posted, thousands of bugs have been fixed, thousands of your ideas and concepts have been proposed and implemented. And there is still more to come!

Along with the release on Steam, update 1.00 was released on all platforms
Changes in the update:
- New block: Custom wheel
- Changed the model of 2 wheels
- Added a smooth appearance for the small wing
- Added display of units of measurement in the numeric field in the block settings
- Changed the interface of some menus
- Changed the effect of rocket engines
- New skin for the character: "Steam punk"
- New category in the reference book: Weapons
- Added display of additional information about the selected block in the pause and block settings menu
- When editing a custom block, it can no longer fall off from other blocks, instead a warning will be shown

Fixes
- Fixed the inability to join a server with a large number of buildings
- Fixed sending quick messages with keyboard buttons on PC
- Changed the effects when colliding and shooting on the "Hangar" map
- Fixed resetting armor improvements when welding a block
- Changed the behavior of the altitude stabilizer
- Fixed dealing explosion damage through blocks in blocks
- Fixed re-installing block on bearing
